body:
Plan, rules and numbers: wf-context/docs-gaps/pass2.md (read "How a section is bound" first). Worktree wf-docs2, branch docs/pass2; DOCS_COMMON.md applies. Per-section list: wf-context/docs-gaps/pass2/out-before/binding-sections.md.

Rules in short: bind claims, not mentions. For each target section, cite the code its claims depend on: `pass2/dsdef.sh <file>#<Symbol> [stable|api]` prints the id (idempotent, writes `//ds:def` in this repo's style), then link the name in the sentence: [`Name`](ds:block?id=<id>). Defaults and limits cite their const. Pitfalls that state library or driver behaviour cite the code (or the test) that makes it true. Snippet-synced Go blocks stay with `task docs:snippets`; bind the prose around them. Only `//ds:def` lines may change in library files. Never run `ds scan`, `ds ack` or `ds refresh` (the coordinator scans and commits `.ds/` once at the end); `ds check` must stay at 0 errors.

Owns: `docs/observability/`, `docs/testing/`, `docs/extending/`, `docs/reliability/`, `docs/reference/`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`; examples: app-tests, batch-tests, claim-check, complete-in-transaction, consumer-inbox, custom-driver, custom-plugin, discard-exhausted, driver-conformance, encrypted-payloads, failover, failover-manage, failover-observer, failure-alerts, fair-share, fake-forks, label-search, lifecycle-events, opentelemetry, outbox, partitioned-runs, recorder-custom-store, recorder-split, recorder-sql, release-jobs, reset-fork, run-all, run-finished, run-recorder, run-repair, scoped-data, secret-guard, sentry-reporting, transactional-enqueue, unique-jobs, unique-states.

Binding now: 34 pages, 216 sections describe library code (Try it and Related excluded), 15 bound.

## Gaps to close

- [ ] Conformance counts drifted with the fix rounds: `go test ./custom-driver -run TestConformance -v` now gives 43 pass and 195 skip (the new storedtimeout wait-timeout case, e1ceb85); extending/writing-a-driver.md:618 and examples/custom-driver/README.md:39 say 194. Fix both, recheck 'every other group (60 of 70)' (writing-a-driver.md:635, examples/driver-conformance/README.md:15), and cite the sentences to the workflowtest group list so the next new case flags them.
- [ ] extending/writing-a-driver.md, Step 7: the step-timeout handshake (`TimeoutError` as the cancel cause, `WithTimeoutClaim`, `ClaimTimeout`, `Harness.StepTimeoutHandshake`) has no example and the section's Go block does not use it: add a region to examples/custom-driver and sync it.
- [ ] observability/run-recorder.md, Archive into a table, exactly once: `sqlrecorder.WithArchiveTable`, `Store.ArchivedRun`, `Store.ArchivedRuns`, `ArchiveQuery`, `ArchivePage` have no example: add a region to examples/recorder-sql (SQLite in memory) and sync it.
- [ ] run-recorder.md, Be told about a failed write: the synced snippet uses a func literal, so `recorder.ErrorFunc` is never named in code; type the hook so the name appears (and `OpSetOutcome` is in the list).
- [ ] Cite the 16 uncovered recorder defs from the page that describes them: rec-withmemoryclock, rec-withmemoryretention, rec-maxsearchlen, rec-validatequery, rec-stepstatus, rec-defaultpluginname, rec-recorder-store, rec-recorder-enqueuemiddleware, rec-recorder-stepmiddleware, rec-recorder-onrunfinished, rectest-driveroption, rec-maxprunebatch, rec-validateretention, sqlrec-schemaversion, sqlrec-withclock, rec-recordpage (`ds map` lists their full ids).
- [ ] Cite instead of typing: recorder `DefaultBackfillPages`, `DefaultBackfillWindow`, `DefaultMaxPayload`, `DefaultPruneBatch`, `DefaultReconcileBatch`, `DefaultReconcileInterval`, `DefaultStaleAfter`, `DefaultWriteTimeout`, `sqlrecorder.DefaultTxAttempts`; `InboxState` (`InboxBusy`, `InboxClaimed`, `InboxDone`) and `ScopeFolder`/`ScopeGlobal`/`ScopeWorkflow` in reliability: no page names them.

## Done when

- [ ] `python3 tools/binding.py` + `tools/batches.py` (see pass2.md) show every target section of this batch bound, or the report names the section and why it states no claim worth binding.
- [ ] `ds check` 0 errors; `task docs:wrap docs:links docs:snippets docs:words` pass; `go test -race` of every example touched.
- [ ] Report wf-context/reports/docs-p2-w6.md with before/after binding counts, defs added (id, file), Shared-file lines, Library bugs, DONE.

## Result (2026-11-21)

Landed with the docs pass 2 commit. 217 of 217 target sections bound; gaps closed; report wf-context/reports/docs-docs2-w6.md. Open for the coordinator: ds check shows 7 unacked lines (6 on run-recorder.md, 1 W3 hatchet.md:704) that need ds scan / ds ack.
